Class ReflectionBeanDefinition.Builder<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.reflection.ReflectionBeanDefinition.Builder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The bean type
Enclosing class:
ReflectionBeanDefinition<T>
public static final class ReflectionBeanDefinition.Builder<T> extends Object
Builds the definition of a type, reading the class for what the builder does not set.
Since:
5.2.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • postConstruct

      public ReflectionBeanDefinition.Builder<T> postConstruct(String... methodNames)
      The methods to invoke once the bean is created and injected, named rather than annotated: a container that names them - the initMethod of a Spring bean definition - has no annotation to read. The methods annotated @PostConstruct are invoked as well, and the arguments of a named method are injected as those of an annotated one are.
      Parameters:
      methodNames - The method names
      Returns:
      This builder
